Requirement to encode:
[source_id: src.cyberchair_access_control_intent.authorization_intent_covered.p0014.l23; section: CyberChair Access Control Intent / Authorization Intent Covered] 12. Reviewer directories and review files are protected from outsiders by per-directory allowed-user lists.

Write one condition atom for each scope below. AutoCedar joins the conditions of a slice with AND and the slices of a scope with OR, so encode only what this requirement says.

Scope accessReviewerDirectory: principal User, action accessReviewerDirectory, resource ReviewerDirectory (every way to allow it is listed).
  It is a condition of slice slice_p0014_dir: User on allowed-user list
  The other conditions of this slice (encoded separately):
    - none
  Approved condition atoms of this scope:
    - none yet

Scope readReviewFile: principal User, action readReviewFile, resource ReviewFile (every way to allow it is listed).
  It is a condition of slice slice_p0014_file: User on allowed-user list
  The other conditions of this slice (encoded separately):
    - none
  Approved condition atoms of this scope:
    - none yet

Rules for interpretation (apply them to every requirement):
  - none
</autocedar_condition_packet>
